title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ServiceCandidate
description: ServiceCandidate is an entity that makes a service specification available to a catalog. A ServiceCandidate and its associated service specification may be published - made visible - in any number of service catalogs, or in none. One service specification can be composed of other service specifications. (TM Forum TMF633 Service Catalog Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition ServiceCandidate; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceCandidate:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ServiceCandidate'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCandidate/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceCandidate:<tmfId>. Unique identifier of this REST resource

href.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCandidate/properties/href'. Hyperlink reference to this REST resource

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCandidate/properties/description'. Description of this REST resource

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCandidate/properties/lastUpdate'. Date and time of the last update of this REST resource

lifecycleStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCandidate/properties/lifecycleStatus'. Used to indicate the current lifecycle status of the service candidate.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCandidate/properties/name'. Name given to this REST resource

version.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCandidate/properties/version'. the version of service candidate

category.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCandidate/properties/category'. List of categories for this candidate. In TMF this is an array of ServiceCategoryRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced ServiceCategory entities (urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceCategory:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

serviceSpecification.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCandidate/properties/serviceSpecification'. The service specification implied by this candidate. In TMF this is a ServiceSpecificationRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced ServiceSpecification entity (urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceSpecification:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCandidate/properties/validFor'. The period for which this REST resource is valid

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCandidate/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCandidate/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF633_ServiceCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF633-ServiceCatalog-4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceCandidate/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'ServiceCandidate' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class entity name

TimePeriod.description: A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

endDateTime.description: End of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format

startDateTime.description: Start of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format. If you define a start, you must also define an end
